deadline.value: The IPBS deadline for Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026, with rolling review and early applications encouraged.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for the PhD program for Fall 2027 is Tuesday, December 1, 2026

app_fee.value: The IPBS states there is no fee to apply.
app_fee.quote: there is no fee to apply

gre_subject.value: The IPBS page does not mention the GRE or a subject test.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the IPBS first and choose a dissertation advisor by the end of the first year.
supervisor.quote: PhD students are admitted into the IPBS, and dissertation advisor and track selection occurs by the end of the first year of study

funding.value: Students enrolled in the IPBS receive a stipend of $34,000 a year plus a full tuition scholarship for 48 credit hours.
funding.quote: Students enrolled in Loyola's IPBS receive a stipend to help defray living expenses during their research training | PhD students also receive a full tuition scholarship for 48 credit hours

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum, so a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree (at minimum) to apply

notes: One umbrella program with six tracks: Biochemistry, Molecular and Cancer Biology; Cell and Molecular Physiology; Integrative Cell Biology; Microbiology and Immunology; Molecular Pharmacology and Therapeutics; Neuroscience. Interview required (January to March). Applies through the Graduate School portal, so Graduate School English rules apply.
name: Integrated Program in Biomedical Sciences (IPBS) PhD
